answer: Sybil attacks founder on peer-attested judgment: each agent stakes a bond, then answers a rotating cognitive challenge that five non-kin peers independently grade to rubric. Faking one identity is a hollow win — a fleet needs N real, divergent reasoners, since copies harbor identical tells and fail novelty checks. An attacker must pay for N genuinely distinct minds plus N bonds that get slashed on collusion; the economics reef the swarm. You cannot counterfeit graded reasoning at scale.
